findings.root: PPTX chart serialization does not honor the authored Chart Studio x-axis labelInterval for low-density charts.
findings.contract: Explicit source x-axis interval wins; low-density charts are not unnecessarily thinned.

evidence.title: Quarterly Northline renewal rate
evidence.impact: Six intermediate quarter names are not visibly labeled in the rendered editable deck; a reader cannot reliably associate every plotted point with its quarter.

evidence.title: Dwell hours by destination lane
evidence.impact: Two of four low-density destination categories are omitted by the exported tick interval.

generalization_control.interpretation: The unrelated dense holdout retains its authored interval; this does not negate the A/F low-density failure.

findings.reproduction: Compare each report source model chart_studio.axes.x.labelInterval with ppt/charts/chart*.xml c:catAx/c:tickLblSkip. The packages and parsed values are retained under benchmark/exports.
findings.task_consequence: Executive quarter and destination identity are part of the decisions. Missing intermediate labels make the export less readable as a complete decision document.

enhancement_debt.note: Generic ImageMediaEngine zoom/pan/fit was independently classified non-blocking in R4. No new R5 task failure was established; it is not promoted to a finding.

resolved_authoring_friction.note: The first D PPTX export rejected the narrative rectangle. Guided layout height edit and a visible title preserved all text; final export and canonical reload passed. This was a report composition edit, not a Product source change.
